Text: The system shall provide security awareness training documentation and compliance attestation mechanisms ensuring that personnel involved in network administration understand security policies and maintain awareness of evolving threat landscapes.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall isolate user data and network traffic using logical network segmentation and virtual private network (VPN) technologies to prevent unauthorized access to telecommunications information by malicious internal or external actors.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall support accountability mechanisms through user identification and session tracking that correlate all network operations to specific authenticated users, enabling investigation of security incidents and policy violations.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall implement cryptographic key management procedures including secure key generation, storage in hardware security modules (HSMs), key rotation schedules, and documented key lifecycle management to protect the confidentiality of encryption keys.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall anonymize or pseudonymize personal data collected during telecommunications network operations through tokenization or data masking techniques where immediate personal identification is not operationally necessary.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall validate the authenticity of network management commands and configuration updates through code signing and certificate-based verification mechanisms before execution on network infrastructure components.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall enforce integrity protection mechanisms on critical telecommunications network data using cryptographic message authentication codes (MACs) or digital signatures to detect unauthorized data modification.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall document security compliance requirements and maintain records demonstrating adherence to telecommunications industry standards such as 3GPP security specifications or equivalent Common Criteria security targets.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall implement secure session management protocols that establish, maintain, and terminate authenticated user sessions with automatic timeout mechanisms and protection against session hijacking attacks.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall provide role-based personal data access controls that restrict network operators' visibility of customer personally identifiable information (PII) to only the minimum data required for their assigned job functions.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall maintain tamper-detection mechanisms and integrity verification capabilities across network infrastructure to immediately alert security administrators when unauthorized modifications to system files, configurations, or audit logs are detected.
Label: Security
